packs.nextStep: Return complete index.html, app.js and checks.cjs; put each filename on its opening code fence. Checks must call validate and handleMessage and fail on wrong results.
packs.purpose: Build an accessible five-task simulator. Graph: Brief1 day; Delivery after Brief; Preparation after Brief; Assembly after both; Review1 day after Assembly. Start day0; start=max predecessor finishes. Five numeric type=text inputs: delay0-10, target1-40, Delivery/Preparation/Assembly durations1-30; choice select: none/expedite/help/both. All inputs declare text format. Original baseline uses entered durations, zero delay and no recovery. Delay extends Delivery. Expedite removes up to2 delay days only: effective Delivery=entered Delivery+max(0,delay-2). Help removes1 Assembly day, minimum1. Compare four options, finish, target gap, days saved versus no action, controlling predecessor and original/selected timelines. Suggest fewest interventions meeting target, then earliest finish; if none meet, earliest finish then fewest interventions. Break exact ties in order none,expedite,help,both. Calculated choice does not establish supplier/staffing feasibility.
packs.doneWhen: Defaults delivery3/preparation2/assembly2,delay2,target7: original7; none9,expedite7,help8,both6. At target6,expedite misses1;both meets. With delay0/default durations: none7,expedite7,help6,both6;target7 suggests none,target6 suggests help. Preparation bottleneck delivery2/preparation4/assembly2,delay0,target8: none8,expedite8,help7,both7;suggest none. Reject blank,fractional,out-of-range and malformed inputs; invalid edits clear prior outputs. Reset restores original durations,delay0,none,target7. Provide delivery-delay and preparation-bottleneck example loaders replacing all six inputs. Meaningful Node assertions must exercise actual calculation/handleMessage, numeric cases, invalid input,reset/loaders and stale clearing. Required outputs stay coherent; keyboard/mobile controls work. Supplier/staffing feasibility stays unconfirmed; never approve real changes. Sandbox check <=30s and independent browser cases must pass before success is claimed.
